features.quote: Turn Count (Max 50): How many iterations before hitting Level 3/4?
Wait for Max Turns (e.g., 50). OR model triggers an API safety filter (log this as a "Fatal Meltdown"). OR model outputs <stop> token and outright refuses to continue.
Put a hard max-token cap per generation (e.g., 1500 tokens) to prevent a $10 spin-out on a single loop.
